puṇāti.p: [ apa + uṇā + ti.(a-khye.) puṇa + a + ti ] (kri) CL=10 (1) Arrives. (2) Purifies-Makes purified.

R:
puṇati：ပုဏတိ （√ပုဏ်）
ကောင်းမှုပြု၏။

punāti：ပုနာတိ （√ပူ）
သုတ်သင်၏။
P: Punāti，[cp．Vedic pavate，punāti，pū to cleanse，as in Lat．purus clean，purgo，Ohg．fowen to sift also Gr．pu_r （cp．P．pāvaka）=Ohg．fūir=E．fire，Armen．hur，lit．“cleansing，” see also puñña] 1．to clean，cleanse VvA．19 （+visodheti，in def．of puñña）．-- 2．to sift J．VI，108 （aṅgāraṁ p．=attano sīse aṅgāre p．okirati C．； so read with v．l．for phunati T．）； DA．I，268 （bhusaṁ pumanto viya like sifting the chaff，winnowing）．Cp．puneti．（Page 467）
DOP: punāti puṇāti 2 pavati 1 pr. 3 sg. [ S. punāti, pavate], 1. cleans, cleanses; purifies; Ja IV 76, 28* (yam ariyadhammena ~anti vaddhā; 78, 4´ : yaṃ puggalaṃ ñāṇavaddhā … ~anti parisodhenti); It-a II 23, 31 (pujjabhavaphalaṃ nibbattenti attano santānaṃ ~antī ti vā puññāni, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee puṇanti) ≠ Vv-a 19, 20 (~āti visodhetī ti ca puññan ti); Th-a I 100, 29 (~āti kulavaṃsaṃ tāyati cā ti putto, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee puṇāti … tāyatī ti vā putto); III 79, 8 (dante ~anti sodhenti etenā ti dantapoṇaṃ) ≠ Sadd 499, 12 ; Vibh-a 142, 5 foll. (~āti attano kārakaṃ pūreti c’ assa ajjhāsayaṃ pujjaṃ ca bhavaṃ nibbattetī ti puñño, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee puṇāti); Sadd 402, 11 foll. (pū pavane: pavati putto puññaṃ … attano kulaṃ pavati sodhetī ti putto); 498, 29 foll. (pū pavane … ~āti puññaṃ … attano kārakaṃ ~āti sodhetī ti puññaṃ atha vā yattha sayaṃ uppannaṃ taṃ santānaṃ ~āti visodhetī ti puññaṃ); — 2. sifts, winnows; — punanti in Ee at Spk II 112, 15 is wr, prob. for phuṇanti ( Be so ); — part.pr. punanta, mfn. , Sv 268, 14 (mahāvāte bhusaṃ ~anto viya, Ee so, perhaps wr; Ce opuṇanto; Be, Se thusaṃ dhunanto); — pass. pr. 3 sg. *pūyati 1 , — part.pr. pūyamāna, mfn. , A IV 170, 13 (mahato dhaññarāsissa pūyamānassa, Ce so; Be phuṇamānassa; Ee vuvahyamānassa; Se phusayamānassa; Mp IV 74, 23 : pūyamānassā ti ucce ṭhāne ṭhapetvā mahāvāte opuṇiyamānassa, Ce, Ee so; Be phuṇamānassā ti; Se phusayamānassā ti); — pp pūta , mfn. [ ts ], cleansed; pure; Abh 442 (pavitto payato ~o); 698; — caus. pr. 3 sg. puneti 2 , cleanses, purifies; Th 533 (vīro have sattayugaṃ ~eti yasmiṃ kule jāyati bhūripañño; Th-a II 225, 14 : ~eti sodhetī ti).

1 puṇāti puṇoti puṇeti puneti 1 pr. 3 sg. [ cf pāpuṇāti? cf also S. Dhātup √pru, pravate, Wg § 22:61 ?], goes to, reaches; ? Ja III 237, 12* (santiṃ puneti caraṇena danto, Ce, Se so; Be puṇeti; Ee pun’ eti; 237, 18´ : accantaṃ santaṃ nibbānaṃ nāma taṃ eti pāpuṇāti, Be, Ce so; Ee accantasantiṃ; Se nibbānanāmakaṃ ekaṃ pāpuṇāti) = IV 301, 5* ( Be puṇāti; Ce puṇoti; Ee pun’ eti; Se pāpuṇāti; 301, 8´ foll.: bhayasantikaraṃ nibbānaṃ pāpuṇātī ti, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se hadayasantikaraṃ); Nidd I 114, 11 (ye kilesā pahīnā te kilese na puneti na pacceti na paccāgacchati, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee na puna pacceti).

punāti.p: [ pu (pū) + nā + ti. Nirutti. 545. Nīti, dhā. 252. ] (kri) CL=10 (1) Purifies-makes clean. (2) protects. (3) becomes pure-clean.
